chapter: Road work, Honolulu and a new name
title: Rhythm and blues repertoire before she knew bebop
summary: Everyone knew Percy Mayfield and Louis Jordan; she had not yet met Dizzy Gillespie or Roach.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Bix Beiderbecke: hearing, copying and remembering him

blocks.x: So, this was in the early '50s. How did the music or the arrangements, the repertoire, reflect the rhythm and blues of that time? Was it a part of what was influencing -­

We were all -- everybody knew who Percy Mayfield was and Louis Jordan. It's like it is today. You can only show what you know. It's the ones who go before us that make it possible for us to do what we do. I didn't know Dizzy Gillespie yet. This is before I met Roach and the music they called be-bop, but I did meet Billie and Louis and Duke Ellington.
